items.title: Basic Commands
items.content:
Use 'sync-run' to start the system.
Use 'sync-stop' to halt processes.
Check status with 'sync-status'.

items.title: Configuration
items.content:
Edit 'config.yaml' to adjust robotic parameters.
Default port: 8080.

items.title: Troubleshooting
items.content:
If errors occur, check logs in /var/log/syncrobotic.
Restart services if necessary.
